overview_description.description:
Otter is a community builder who is passionate about helping families thrive on their own terms. 

The company's platform helps to meet with nearby stay-at-home parents who offer a parenting approach and can take care of kids, enabling parents to manage their scheduling, payment, and pick-up and drop-off logistics. It also connects parents who need childcare with a stay at home parents who can care for their kids.

Otter was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
